description: Identity quality canon for character consistency across shots and scenes.

quality_dimensions.name: Reference Match
quality_dimensions.description: Character must match the approved identity reference.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Facial structure, hair, and key identifying traits match reference.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Character appears as a different person.

quality_dimensions.name: Cross-Shot Consistency
quality_dimensions.description: Character must be recognizable across different shots and angles.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Same character recognizable in wide, medium, and close shots.

quality_dimensions.name: Age Consistency
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: No unintended aging or de-aging between shots.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Character looks significantly older or younger without narrative cause.
